title: Service status
subtitle: Current observations, incidents and maintenance
unavailable: Status is unavailable. Check the connection or try again.
empty: No visible components. An administrator can configure monitors and viewing permissions in Manage.
wholeHours: History clips requested intervals and excludes maintenance and pauses. Unknown coverage never counts as healthy; each bar shows the worst observed state for that interval.
name: Internal label
publicComponent: Allow this component on the public page
failed: The change could not be saved. Reload to check its current revision.
plainHTTP: Allow plaintext HTTP on the explicitly allowed private network
grantHint: Select current Portal users/OUs. Descendants inherit OU read grants. Financial permission is separate.
secretHint: Saved values are never returned. Leave blank when editing to preserve the secret.
accountBalanceHint: Balances belong to an account, not an individual key. Qwen uses Alibaba billing credentials; model quotas are a separate capability.
deleteApproval: I confirm this credential can be deleted
publicHint: Only components and incident narratives explicitly published by an administrator appear publicly. Amounts and internal targets remain private.
resumeHint: Review this queue before resuming. Changes invalidate this review. Started deliveries may already have reached Portal.
reviewed: I reviewed the current queue and potential duplicate publication
publisherHint: Create one Portal token with scope notify:status-<component ID> per component, then review the matching notification rule. Read grants and notification recipients are separate policies.
privateOnly: Open this app from the Portal application hub.
checkSavedHint: Checks use the saved configuration. Save edits first. Paused probes remain paused.
checkQueued: Check queued. Wait for a new observation; this does not confirm availability.
billingUnsupportedHint: This billing capability is unavailable for the configured account/site. Review Alibaba billing access; no balance has been inferred. Model quota is a separate capability.
billingPermissionHint: Billing access was refused. Use a minimal RAM identity authorized for QueryAccountBalance; a model API key does not grant billing access.
billingSiteHint: Billing site does not match this account. Check China/international configuration.
currencyHint: The selected currency was not reported. Balances in other currencies are not converted or summed.
authenticationHint: Authentication failed. Review the saved credential; no balance or availability was inferred.
observerHint: The observer could not finish this check. This does not establish a target outage.
staleHint: This observation is stale. Wait for a fresh check before relying on it.
accountRefHint: Use one local reference for each real billing account (lowercase letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore; up to 64 characters). Keys sharing an account belong to one component. Verify account ownership yourself; the balance API cannot identify shared accounts reliably.
invalidConfiguration: Check the required fields, target, network ranges, credential and billing account reference. Your edits are preserved.
configurationConflict: The configuration changed or this action is currently blocked. Check the current revision, pause and lease state before retrying. Your edits are preserved.
requestBusy: Too many requests. Wait briefly and retry. Your edits are preserved.
accessDenied: Access is unavailable or your permissions changed. Sign in again or ask an administrator to review access.
itemUnavailable: This item is unavailable. Review your current access and refresh the list.
httpConditionHint: Leave status empty to require any 2xx response. Text matching is literal and limited to 256 characters; redirects and rate limits never count as success. Response bodies are not saved.
exportReady: Authorized snapshot prepared. Select the text to copy it.
exportCopyHint: The sandbox keeps the export as selectable text. Copy it to a local file. Financial values are included only with current finance permission.
retentionHint: Raw observations: 1–30 days. Aggregates, resolved incidents and completed notices: up to 90 days, at least the raw retention. Active incidents and pending notices retain required evidence. Shorter periods are applied by background cleanup.
backendUpgradeRequired: The paired Status backend does not support the capabilities required by this app. Deploy the matching verified service artifact and refresh.
backendNotReady: Backend compatibility could not be verified. Status data is not displayed until the connection and service capabilities are verified.
postgresUnixHint: Uses the database socket mounted by your deployment administrator. No network host or proxy container is needed.
postgresSocketHint: The local database connection is unavailable. Ask the deployment administrator to check the socket mount and database access.
privateDefaultHint: Only administrators can see a new component until you choose other viewers.
checksHint: Choose what to check. Timing and network options use safe defaults and can be expanded when needed.
credentialSetupHint: Add the matching credential in Credentials first. Saved secrets are never displayed.
difyReadHint: Reads application information only; no workflow or model inference is executed.
componentsHint: Manage checks and who can see their results.
credentialDeleteHint: Credentials in use cannot be deleted. Stop or reassign their monitors before removing them.
probeControlHint: Checks continue in the background when this page is closed.
notificationControlHint: Notification delivery is controlled separately from monitoring. Recipients are configured in Portal.
